typography.body: Inter or system sans-serif, text-base, leading-relaxed

layouts.hero: Full height or min-h-[80vh] centered content, large text, glowing background accents. Two CTA buttons.
layouts.bento_grid: Asymmetric grid for 'How it Works' or Personas (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6).
layouts.feature_pillars: Alternating left/right image-text blocks OR grid-2 layout per pillar, using glass cards for sub-features.
layouts.trust_band: Horizontal flex, gap-8, items-center, justify-center, opacity-80.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 between major sections.

motion.entrance: fade-up (existing class) with staggered delays for grid items.
motion.hover: glass-hover (existing class) for cards. Elevate (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity/glow.
motion.accents: Slow pulsing opacity on background radial gradients to simulate neon breathing.

component_instructions.buttons: Use 'btn btn-primary' for primary actions. Use 'btn btn-ghost' or outline with neon accent for secondary.
component_instructions.cards: Wrap in 'glass' class. Sub-features inside pillars should be smaller glass cards with a lucide-react icon.
component_instructions.badges: Use 'chip' pill component for tags like 'New', 'Live', 'Beta'.

navigation_decluttering_guidance.instruction: The logged-in top navigation must be consolidated into grouped dropdown menus to reduce cognitive overload.
navigation_decluttering_guidance.settings: Move 'Settings' to a user avatar dropdown menu at the far right.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Generous padding creates a premium feel.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states elevate the design.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients or images has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow if needed).
accessibility.interactive: All buttons and links must have explicit focus states.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all custom animations.
